name: Liam O'Connell
bio:
Liam's journey into motorsport began with a childhood obsession with rally cars tearing through the Irish countryside. He honed his analytical skills at Dublin Institute of Technology, graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering before landing a junior role at a small Formula Ford team. He quickly proved his worth, developing innovative suspension setups that helped the team punch above their weight. 

Liam's pragmatic approach centers on data-driven decision-making. He excels at identifying critical performance bottlenecks and implementing practical solutions. While he respects cutting-edge research, he prioritizes reliable, proven technologies that deliver consistent results. His time with Akkodis ASP Team has been marked by a steady stream of incremental improvements that have helped the team stay competitive. Liam is a firm believer in simple solutions and never overcomplicates things.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: Liam is of average height, with a focused, intense gaze.
